To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MindFinder enables users sketch and tag images in a bilateral interactive fashion.

MindFinder enables users with a sketch and tags to search for images in the database, and the results are updated in real time as users refine the query by adding, deleting, and moving tags and sketches.
MindFinder enables users sketch and tag image queries at object level, which is a novel way to interact with image search engines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following two questions: (1) how to enable users to flexibly formulate their queries in a natural manner; (2) how to return the most relevant images to the query in an interactive manner.
how to help users to present and refine their queries in their mind by leveraging a huge repository, and finally turn their thoughts to a beautiful picture.

the following questions: (1) How to enable interactive sketching and tag-based search on a large image database, (2) What are the most important features for interactive image search, (3) What is the optimal way to present search results to users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MindFinder is a system which enables users to sketch, tag, and search images interactively and efficiently.

MindFinder enables users with the ability of sketching and tagging to interactively search for images from an image database, which is able to help them to find the most relevant images from the database.
MindFinder is a system that enables users to present and refine their thoughts by sketching and tagging images, and finally turn them into a beautiful image(s).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to build a bridge between users' mind and image database.
MindFinder provides a platform to bridge the gap between the mind and the world.
we have developed a new image search system which enables users to search by interactive sketch and tags.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MindFinder can help users to formulate their queries in a natural and intuitive way, which is not possible with existing image retrieval systems.
MindFinder provides a more intuitive, flexible and efficient way to interact with the image database.

we have demonstrated a novel way of interactive image search that can help users present their initial thoughts in the mind, and then refine the thoughts by the help of search results, which is a new paradigm of interactive image search.
